rules_version: demo-2026-v2 (configure from the AICTE Approval Process Handbook)

R01.text: Required document for this application category is missing

R02.text: Document unreadable, low OCR confidence or unclassifiable: manual review
R02.handbook_ref: Process: manual review of unreadable evidence

R03.handbook_ref: Handbook: validity of statutory documents (configure clause)

R04.text: Document expires within the warning window

R05.text: Institution ID in document differs from application form

R06.text: Institution name in document differs from application form

R07.text: Intake in document differs from intake claimed in form

R08.text: Intake claimed in form differs from AICTE record (approved intake)

R09.text: Identical file uploaded more than once (duplicate)

R10.text: PDF metadata anomaly (edited long after creation / image-editing software)

R11.text: Issuer verification result is not 'Verified' (see status)

R12.text: AICTE record shows unpaid TER or open deficiency

R13.text: Irregular dates (issue date after expiry or in the future)

R14.text: Photo visually matches an image submitted by a different institution (perceptual hash)

R15.text: Photo GPS location is far from the declared campus location

R16.text: Photo quality too low to serve as evidence (blur / resolution)

R17.text: QR code reference differs from the printed reference number
R17.handbook_ref: Process: verification via QR / reference number

R18.text: PDF forensic indicator (mixed fonts in a data field / multiple incremental saves)

R19.text: ML anomaly detector flags unusual file characteristics (advisory)
